The '''Battle of Asteroid 426''' took place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Background==
{{Quote|General Tann is en route with an elite task force. With the help of Confederacy cruisers, we should be able to penetrate this maze and clear the way for an invasion.|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]|<ref name="GB:CC" />}}
In order for [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] plan of invading the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Sarapin/Legends|Sarapin]], the CIS needed to destroy the primary planetary defense grid in the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] maze.

[[File:Asteroid_426_Power_Relay.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces defending the Power Relay on [[Asteroid 426]].]]

==The battle==
Arriving with the Separatist forces, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] was instructed by Dooku to fight through the [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] grid defenses to [[Asteroid 426]], located outside of Sarapin in the planet's ring. It wasn't easy as the field was filled with Heavy Anti-Air turrets, which would destroy the fighters and the rest of the force very quickly. Fortunately with Confederacy cruisers, which were brought to assist Tann, she was able to slowly make way to the asteroid with facing a little resistance from the Republic fighters.
Eventually making it to the asteroid, she destroyed the supply depots, so she could get enough resources to set up a base on it. Meanwhile the Republic troops stationed on the asteroid led periodic attacks to the enemy base, though it didn't faze them at all.
Then, after gathering enough troops, she devastated the rest of the Republic forces and destroyed the power relay to Sarapin's shield.

==Aftermath==
Following the collapse of the planetary shield at the hands of the Confederacy, Sarapin was then left for the taking.
